run_download_index: run the CLI to download a precomputed ATLAS index for the wiki-dec2018 corpus
run_download_index_help: run the CLI with --help to list all available ATLAS indices and descriptions
run_download_index_custom_output: run the CLI with --output_directory to download an index to a custom path
summarize_main: summarize the main function that downloads 128 shards of passages and embeddings for an index
review_get_passage_path: review the get_passage_path function that builds a passage file path from an index and shard number
